Legal operations

Legal Ops Workbench

I built a workbench that lets an in-house legal team follow a vendor review from the written terms to a launch decision.

Independent project

The problem

A vendor review can span several documents and teams. When terms change, someone needs to know what was agreed, where it was written and who needs to act.

The decision

I linked findings to the exact clauses that support them. I also put vendor review, contract changes, past exceptions, signed terms, deadlines and launch approvals in one case so the team can follow a finding through to action.

What you can try

In the guided tour, review a fictional transcription vendor, find a change to the liability cap and see which launch approval needs a second look when the recording retention period changes. The tour uses prepared results.
